# Telehealth Navigator AI

> An independent, educational website at telehealthnavigatorai.com that helps people in the U.S. understand telehealth and online therapy options: how online therapy, psychiatry, and telehealth platforms work, how cost and insurance coverage work, privacy considerations, and how to prepare for a first appointment. It includes condition-specific guides, platform comparisons, cost and insurance tools, and an AI chat guide.

The site does not provide therapy, medical advice, diagnosis, prescriptions, or crisis services. In a crisis in the U.S., call or text 988 or call 911. Content is written and edited by the site editor, Paul Paradis; guides that a registered nurse (Lisa Lewis, RN, BSN) has reviewed for safety language say so near the top. The site is supported by display advertising; as of October 22, 2026 no link on the site pays a commission (see the Affiliate Disclosure). Prices and insurance coverage change often and should be confirmed with providers.
